final: WITH per_status AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(1.0 * "T-BIL" / NULLIF(CRE, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date >= '1985-04-22' AND Date <= '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio FROM per_status) SELECT p.CENTROMEA, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_ratio, p.avg_ratio / NULLIF(o.overall_avg_ratio, 0) AS ratio_over_overall_mean FROM per_status AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
